description: Observation to adjoining Borough - London Borough of Hackney reference: 2026/1827 for the approval of reserved matters in relation to condition 2 of outline planning permission 2011/0734 (as amended) for the access, appearance, layout, landscaping and scale for Phase 4 (Development Zones G and H), comprising details of two buildings of six-storeys, providing 175 residential units with associated plant, cycle storage, refuse and recycling facilities, ancillary residential space, parking and servicing, landscaping, play space,   a   multi-use   games   area   (MUGA),   public   realm   works   and   associated   access arrangements. For the purposes of consultation: This Reserved Matters Application should be read alongside pending Section 73 application ref: 2026/0685, which proposes amendments to the outline parameter framework. The Reserved Matters Application has been prepared having regard to those proposed amendments and is intended to be determined following the determination of ref: 2026/0685. [2026/1827].
